description: Hand-written synthetic fixture. Times are seconds from an arbitrary epoch; memory is a synthetic constant capacity in GB. Not derived from any AWS account, log or bill.
notes: env-a: three-way overlap at [30, 35], a zero-length request at 60, gaps at [0, 10], [50, 70] and [90, 100].
env-b: concurrency up to 3 over [20, 25]; equal shares produce non-terminating fractions (thirds).
env-c: no requests at all, so its whole lifetime is residual.
env-a and env-b overlap in wall-clock time; they are integrated independently.
